[[Knights of San Fernando]] |TV actor =See [[#Behind the scenes|below]] }} '''Brotherhood scribes''',"[[The Beginning]]" episode script also known as '''technicians''',Identified in "[[The End (episode)|The End]]" audio description are a group of characters within the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== {{main|Brotherhood of Steel ranks}} These scribes are members of the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] chapter known as the [[Knights of San Fernando]] who are tasked with operating various types of technology. Their uniform consists of a black vest over a grey uniform shirt and a red scarf. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The End (episode)|The End]]=== A scribe draws a portrait of [[Siggi Wilzig]] on a grid based on information received on the radio. Several scribes are later present when [[Quintus]] gives a mission briefing to the [[knight (TV series)|knights]] and their [[squire (TV series)|squires]]. ===[[The Head]]=== A scribe operates another radio in the background while [[Shortsight]] talks to [[Maximus]], who is pretending to be [[Titus]]. ===[[The Beginning]]=== [[Dane (TV series)|Dane]] is seen wearing a scribe uniform following their injury, after which [[Maximus]] took their place as squire. Several other scribes are also present when Maximus arrives in [[Filly]]. ==Appearances== Brotherhood scribes appear {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|1=101|3=103|8=108|10=202|11=203}} ==Behind the scenes== * These characters are portrayed by uncredited background performers, including [[Kazuo Salazar]].[https://archive.ph/qVfMK Kazuo Salazar on Instagram (archived)] * The word "scribe" is not used in season 1 they are only identified as such in the script for season 1 finale "[[The Beginning]]," released in 2025 as part of the Hugo Award voter packet, but not publicly available. They are called "technicians" in the audio description for "[[The End (episode)|The End]]." ** However, the second season confirms them to be scribes. In "[[The Golden Rule]]," [[Dane (TV series)|Dane]] is referred to as a scribe, and two credited characters are the [[warehouse scribe]]s. ==Gallery== Dane The Beginning.png|Scribe [[Dane (TV series)|Dane]]
